cim_eredeti: Tencent says its Hy4 joins 'top-tier' of open-source AI models
szoveg_eredeti:
Chinese tech giant says latest model is competitive with Anthropic, OpenAI releases

Tencent has pivoted from proprietary to open-source AI models in order to attract customers to its related cloud services. © Reuters

HONG KONG -- Tencent Holdings announced its latest artificial intelligence large language model, Hy4, on Wednesday, claiming the LLM would "break into the top tier of open source AI models for the first time."

prioritas.cim_hu: A Tencent bemutatta a Hy4 modellt, amely felveszi a versenyt a vezető nyílt MI-modellekkel
prioritas.lead_hu: A kínai Tencent bejelentette a legújabb, Hy4 nevű nagy nyelvi modelljét. A vállalat állítása szerint az nyílt forráskódú modelljük felveszi a versenyt az OpenAI és az Anthropic megoldásaival.
